intro: Malachi is the last book of the Old Testament.
In chapters one and two, God answers the people's tired questions, and calls out careless worship.
In chapters three and four, he promises a messenger who will prepare the way, and the rising of the Sun of righteousness.
Little is known of Malachi, whose name means my messenger.
After this book, about four hundred years pass before the New Testament. Listen for the promise of the one who is coming.
